title: Releasing the loop body
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be Boolean finite Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, choose a mode bit and an input word $x$, and let $c$ be a configuration of $B$ on $x$, $w$ a Boolean word, and $f$ a configuration of $F$ on $x$. One step of the loop host from the call configuration with startup enabled, body configuration $c$ halted, release disabled, and flag false produces the call configuration with startup disabled, body state set to $a$, release enabled, and blank flag; the word, fuel configuration, and remaining configuration data are preserved.

configuration f of F on x
